title: Epistemic Stance Markers: Ennek fényében, Mindebből következően, and Mindezek dacára

sections.title: The Structural Mechanism
sections.content: Advanced argumentation requires explicit signaling of logical transitions. In C1 writing, instead of simple *ezért* or *így*, sophisticated authors use compound relational expressions like *ennek fényében* (in light of this) to re-evaluate previous evidence, or *mindebből következően* (consequently from all this) to launch a deductive breakthrough.

sections.title: Rhetorical Application & Stance
sections.content: When holding firm against accumulated counter-evidence or adversity, *mindezek dacára* (in spite of all this) conveys a resolute rhetorical defiance: *A történelem tragédiái mindezek dacára sem tudták kioltani az egyetemes humanizmus eszméjét.* Note the postpositional behavior of *dacára* governing the sublative (*-ra/-re*).

sections.title: Patterns in Context
rows: Ennek fényében újra kell értékelnünk az adatokat.
In light of this, we must re-evaluate the data.
Consequently from all this, the accusation is groundless.
A nehézségek dacára folytatták a munkát.
In spite of the difficulties, they continued the work.
